iti21:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā. vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ.
iti21:2.1: idāhaṃ bhikkhave ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ pasannacittaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi:
iti21:2.2: “imamhi cāyaṃ samaye puggalo kālaṃ kareyya yathā’bhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
iti21:2.5: cetopasāda hetu kho pana bhikkhave evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantī ti.
iti21:6.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā. iti me sutanti.
